role: Semantic graph minimum viable population (MVP) check gating semantic query activation
detail: Validates semantic graph density before enabling semantic query procedures. Enforces five thresholds: (1) minimum 30 semantic facts (excludes DENOTES), (2) minimum 3 concept clusters (IS_A target nodes), (3) minimum 5 semantic edge types with active edges, (4) minimum 3 cross-domain DENOTES bridges, (5) mean 5+ facts per cluster. Exports three check implementations: check_semantic_mvp (persistence-based, backend-agnostic), check_semantic_mvp_neo4j (single optimized Cypher query for large graphs), check_semantic_mvp_auto (auto-selects best available). MVPCheckResult dataclass returns ready boolean, all five metric counts, readiness percentage (0-100, computed as min of sub-percentages), edge_type_distribution dict, cluster_node_ids frozenset, and human-readable failure messages. format_mvp_status() produces guardian-facing summary. Integration points: SemanticQueryHandler and DevelopmentalGate call check_semantic_mvp before executing queries; honest-ignorance response on failure.
constants: _SEMANTIC_EDGE_TYPES=(IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, LACKS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, LOCATED_IN, USED_FOR, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, ACHIEVES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES, CONTRADICTS, SIMILAR_TO, OPPOSITE_OF)
gotchas: check_semantic_mvp_neo4j has fallback logic for cluster_node_id availability (uses elementId if prop_node_id not present); readiness_pct computed as min(sub_pcts) so single threshold bottleneck is bottleneck; mean_facts_per_cluster allows natural variation via mean not per-cluster minimum; DENOTES edges counted separately from 16 semantic types per CANON A.20
